text: A first key on the plain alphabet's table, a grid move, a second key on the KRYPTOS table (or the reverse): the two halves of the sculpture's alphabets used in turn. 0080 tried both keys on one table.

Each known letter ties one letter of the first key to one of the second, one to one; following the ties decides every setting exactly: 844 moves, key lengths 2-14 each, on K4 and ten scrambled copies.
At every level of checks K4 sits inside the copies' range (5 or more: 388 against 300-504). Closed.
